title: dysoxylum arborescens var. timorense
intro: Dysoxylum arborescens var. timorense, commonly known as the Timor Dysoxylum, is a species of plant within the family Meliaceae, native to Timor Island. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing fever and promoting wound healing. Its therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic properties, making it a valuable resource for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Dysoxylum arborescens var. timorense include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
